newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila fails to lure bidders for steel company.
newsitem.headline: Manila fails to lure bidders for steel company.

text.p: The Philippine government declared the bidding for a 7.5 percent stake in National Steel Corp on Tuesday a failure because noone put in any bids.
State-agency National Development Corp (NDC) said it would negotiate with interested buyers for thes 7.5 percent stake in the steel firm up to 3 p.m. (0700 GMT) today.
"As there was no bid submitted, I formally declare the bidding as a failure," NDC assistant general manager Maria Lourdes Rebueno told reporters.
NDC holds 12.5 percent in the steel firm. The majority stake of 82.5 percent is held by Hottick Investments ltd of Hong Kong and five percent by Marubeni Corp.
On Friday, Mitsui & Company Ltd and Bank Paribas expressed interestin joining the bidding for just over 168 million NSC shares with an indicative price of 10 pesos each.
NSC is the country's largest producer of semi-finished steel products.
